Game Your Game Inc., an artificial intelligence-powered sports technology company focused on golf, will begin trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on Thursday under the ticker symbol GYGY through a direct listing.

Chief Executive Officer Soumya Das said the listing marks a milestone for the company as it prepares to expand its commercial launch, grow its subscriber base and further develop its GameGolf AI platform.

AI Golf Platform And Product Capabilities

The Palo Alto, California-based company said its golf technology has been used in more than 140 countries since 2014. Its platform has mapped more than 36,000 golf courses, tracked more than 3 million rounds and recorded more than 300 million golf shots.

The company's flagship GameGolf KZN AI platform combines shot-tracking hardware with subscription-based software. The system uses club-mounted sensors, GPS tracking and artificial intelligence to automatically record shots and provide golfers with performance analytics and on-course recommendations.

Game Your Game said its Smart Caddie feature uses players' shot history and course data to recommend clubs, target lines and expected scores. The company plans to add weather and elevation data to the platform in the future.

Golf Market Opportunity

According to the company, about 48.1 million Americans played golf in 2025, while the R&A estimates there are more than 108 million golfers worldwide.

Direct Listing Advisers

Maxim Group LLC served as the company's exclusive financial adviser for the direct listing. Mitchell Silberberg & Knupp LLP acted as legal counsel.

Building Wealth Across More Than Just the Market

Building a resilient portfolio means thinking beyond a single asset or market trend. Economic cycles shift, sectors rise and fall, and no one investment performs well in every environment. That's why many investors look to diversify with platforms that provide access to real estate, fixed-income opportunities, precious metals, and even self-directed retirement accounts. By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry.

AI高尔夫平台及产品能力

这家总部位于加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托的公司表示，自 2014 年以来，其高尔夫技术已在 140 多个国家/地区使用。 其平台已绘制了超过 36,000 个高尔夫球场的地图，跟踪了超过 300 万轮比赛并记录了超过 3 亿次高尔夫球击球。

该公司的旗舰产品 GameGolf KZN 人工智能平台将击球跟踪硬件与基于订阅的软件相结合。 该系统使用安装在球杆上的传感器、GPS 跟踪和人工智能来自动记录击球情况，并为高尔夫球手提供表现分析和球场建议。

Game Your Game表示，其智能球童功能利用球员的击球历史和球场数据来推荐球杆、目标线和预期得分。 该公司计划将来在该平台上添加天气和海拔数据。

不仅仅在市场上创造财富

建立有弹性的投资组合意味着超越单一资产或市场趋势的思维。 经济周期发生变化，行业兴衰，没有一项投资在所有环境下都能表现良好。 这就是为什么许多投资者希望通过提供房地产、固定收益机会、贵金属甚至自我管理退休账户的平台来实现多元化。 通过将风险分散到多个资产类别，可以更轻松地管理风险、获得稳定的回报并创造不只与一家公司或行业的命运挂钩的长期财富。
